english.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual choice when ecstatic mainly means extremely happy or delighted.
Use this colloquial emphatic phrase to stress that someone is exceptionally happy.

examples.english: I got the job today and I’m ecstatic!
examples.traditional: 今日收到份工，真係開心到飛起！
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 sau1 dou2 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 hoi1 sam1 dou3 fei1 hei2

examples.english: I was elated when I won concert tickets.
examples.traditional: 抽中演唱會門票，我開心到飛起。
examples.jyutping: cau1 zung3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 mun4 piu3 ngo5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 fei1 hei2
